repository_can: route requirements, hazards, standards candidates and evidence
run deterministic checks and reject stale or missing evidence
show open gates without converting them into passes
repository_cannot: authorize placing in service or railway operation
authority_boundary.statement: This model records what evidence exists, what remains open, who must decide, and which use is permitted. It does not certify a component, appoint a legal duty holder, approve a design, release manufacture or construction, authorize operation, or replace an independent assessor or competent authority.

model.change_rule: A changed identity, use, requirement, implementation, interface, environment or acceptance condition reopens the affected gate and every dependent later gate.

gates.name: Define
gates.question: Is the item, reference function, boundary, owner and exact source configuration known?

gates.name: Assure the design
gates.question: Are applicable requirements, hazards, standards, interfaces and verification plans complete for this item?

gates.decision_owner: quality and technical authorities with required independence
gates.name: Qualify the implementation
gates.question: Does the actual software, manufactured item or construction product meet the frozen design?
reopen_when: implementation, supplier, process, toolchain or material changes

gates.decision_owner: system integrator, operator and project safety authority
minimum_evidence: FAT/SAT/HIL or site-test evidence as applicable
gates.name: Validate the integration
gates.question: Does the installed item work safely with its real interfaces, environment, route and operating procedures?
reopen_when: installation, route, environment, interface or operating concept changes

gates.decision_owner: named independent assessor, duty holder and competent authority
minimum_evidence: closed actions and accepted residual risk
regulatory or contractual authorization where required
gates.name: Accept and authorize
gates.question: Have independent reviewers and the legally competent organizations accepted the evidence for the stated use?
reopen_when: changed law or conditions of use

model.principle: one passport per controlled item, five gates, route-specific evidence, one system acceptance
model.roll_up_rule: Component evidence may support a subsystem or system case, but no parent can pass a gate while a safety-significant child or interface remains open or stale.
